$comment: The CLOSED list of modules (blueprint section 4, ADR 0084 part 1). A module is the ONLY code extension point of a pack: a pack turns modules on, code reads module flags, nothing reads a pack id. Adding a module is a code change (a migration for packs.modules, a guard where it owns tables); adding a business type is data only. `exists_today` is true when the repository already has working code and tables for the module: the default pack (textiles) must keep every such module on. `guard` says how the database refuses a module that is off: tables (a before-insert trigger on each table the module owns), agents (an agent run of a mapped agent is refused), flag (no table of its own: the screens and the API read the flag; its output lands in guarded tables), future (the module's tables arrive with its job and register their guards then; the module is on only in packs that list it).
